We need DBE for C15H13O3Cl. DBE formula: DBE = C - H/2 + N/2 +1 (ignoring halogens as H). For halogens, treat as H. So effective H = H + halogens = 13 + 1 =14. No N. So DBE = C - (H_eff)/2 +1 = 15 - 14/2 +1 = 15 -7 +1 =9. So integer 9.

We could retrieve formula via tool but we already know. Might still call retrieve_dbe_formula for completeness. Use tool.
